name: app-installer-builder
description: Wrap an existing website or Node project as a desktop app with Electron and electron-builder: detects a static site (dist/ with index.html) or a Node server, generates desktop/ with the Electron shell (static sites served at app:// with SPA routes; Node servers started with Electron's own Node on a free port), electron-builder.yml for macOS dmg and Windows nsis (plus Linux AppImage), an icon and a README. Shows which targets this computer can build and runs the build with a live log. Signing is optional and only uses a certificate you provide; otherwise builds are unsigned and the README says so.

Shows which targets this computer can build and runs the build with a live log. Signing is optional and only uses a certificate you provide; otherwise builds are unsigned and the README says so.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 用 Electron + electron-builder 把现有网站或 Node 项目包装成桌面应用：自动识别静态网站（含 index.html 的 dist/）或 Node 服务，在项目里生成 desktop/ 目录——Electron 外壳（静态站点通过 app:// 加载并支持前端路由；Node 服务用 Electron 自带的 Node 在空闲端口启动）、面向 macOS dmg 和 Windows nsis（另含 Linux AppImage）的 electron-builder.yml、图标和说明。面板显示本机能打哪些安装包，并实时显示打包日志。签名可选，只使用你自己提供的证书；没有证书就不签名，并在说明里写明。
